mods.name: Infinite Health
mods.description: Restores max HP ([rbx+0x11C]) into current HP ([rbx+0x118]) inside SetHealth. The stub is EFLAGS-safe (pushfq/popfq): the instruction right after the hook site is a 'jbe' that consumes flags set before the store, so a plain 'cmp' in the stub crashes the game. Tested on firmware 14.00.

mods.name: Infinite Credits (nothing is ever spent)
mods.description: Neuters the inventory remover: 'sub r12d,edx' -> 'test r12d,r12d', so a slot quantity is written back unchanged while the following 'jle' still gets correct flags. Credits are an inventory item, so this also stops weapon-upgrade costs. Consumables are not used up either. Note: your balance never rises, it only stops falling - you still cannot buy what you cannot already afford. Tested on firmware 14.00.

mods.name: Stop Time Puzzles (Final Transmission)
mods.description: NOPs the write to the puzzle time-scale field ([rdi+0x20C]). Direct port of the 01.26 cheat; the instruction is unique in the image. NOT verified in game yet - no Final Transmission puzzle was reached during testing.
